result.instructions: Tools for the threads of this channel. You can list, read, start and send; you cannot interrupt a running turn. Your messages reach a thread marked as the supervisor's.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List the threads of this channel: number, state, title, who started it, and the last line of output.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read one thread of this channel: its state, its open question if any, and the end of its latest output.

number.description: the thread's number, as list_threads shows it

tools.name: send_to_thread
tools.description: Send a message to a thread of this channel. A thread that is running a turn refuses it with "busy"; you are told when its turn ends, and can send then. A thread waiting on a question takes the message as the answer.

number.description: the thread's number, as list_threads shows it

tools.name: start_thread
tools.description: Start a new thread in this channel, with its own workspace cloned from a repository.

effort.description: the effort; leave out for the channel's default

model.description: the model; leave out for the channel's default

text.description: the first message; its first line becomes the title
